stories.headline: Lawmakers Move to Exempt More Banks From Debit Card Fee Caps
stories.body: Two bills passed Tuesday (May 12) by the House of Representatives are only the latest efforts by lawmakers to cut red tape for smaller banks. stories.headline: Alabama community bank to introduce digital small-business brand
stories.body: The 22nd State Bank in Mobile has been developing its national Always.bank subsidiary over the past year. 22nd State, which was founded in 1917, eyeing a summertime launch for the online unit.
